gitPolicy: No push. Workers make no branches, worktrees, stashes or commits. Finalization makes one local commit. Evidence goes under tmp/vim-20261111/<planId>/<attempt>/ and stays untracked.

reviewContext.userProblem: The vim engine is ported into src/vim at f204032, but emaki has no public emaki/vim entry, no way to customize or persist keymaps at runtime, and the Tauri example cannot enable vim, load a user keymap or map ex commands to file actions.
requiredOutcomes: src/vim/index.ts implements C2: vim(options) returns a ModalKeyHook plus attach(editor, host), state, cursorShape and onChange; block cursor in normal mode; :, / and ? prompt editing; jsdom integration test drives createEditor with vim (i, type, Esc, dd, u, /search, :s).

Keymap customization: vim({keymap|preset}) and runtime setKeymap without re-creating the editor; invalid keymaps report issues without breaking; exports compileKeymap, KEYMAP_MAX_BYTES, KEYMAP_PRESETS, KeymapStore and LocalKeymapStore; LocalKeymapStore round trip tested.

Tauri example: #vim toggle, #vim-mode indicator, :w/:wq/:x/:q/:q!/:e/:e path mapped to save/close/open, Cmd+N/O/S in all modes, user keymap via status-bar dialog button persisted in localStorage with issues shown; smoke extended (vim basics, :w, :e, custom jj keymap) and passing; native debug build succeeds.
Core bundle bytes for users not importing emaki/vim are unchanged (scripts/bundle-size.mjs); README documents emaki/vim, keymap customization and the Tauri vim/keymap features.
Root npm run check, npm test, npm run build pass; example npm run check, build, smoke and cargo test pass.
nonGoals: Re-porting or re-auditing engine test parity (vim-p01 closed by operator decision).
user-qa #1 (native cursor shape) and user-qa #5 (config-dir keymap); both deferred.
Non-additive C1 changes, new EditorOptions or ModalKeyHook members, a public timer option, core src edits outside src/vim (except p07's conditional input fix).
Keymap editor UI, undo preservation across a vim toggle, runtime hook swap, IME in prompts, copy interception.
constraints: vactr and chilla are read-only; no file under src/, test/ or scripts/ may contain vactr, solid-js or /editor/.
C1 engine contract changes are additive only (setKeymap, cmdline).
emaki/vim stays framework-independent; the core entry never imports vim; @codemirror/state and @codemirror/commands remain the only peers.
No npm install; package-lock.json and Cargo.lock unchanged.
Rust uses ~/.cargo/bin/cargo with PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"; never the mise shim.
Commit in emaki; gitPush=false. Archive all vim-* plans to impl-plans/completed at the end (plan-archive node).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Rev 4 redispatch from f204032: p01, p02, p04 and p05 are accepted dependencies; remaining plans are p08, p09, p03, p06, p10 and p07.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Those plans landed in f204032; the rev 3 waves for p03, p06 and p07 are superseded by the rev 4 plan files.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D10: keymaps are compiled in the adapter and applied through an additive C1 setKeymap; a failed compile keeps the previous keymap and issues are surfaced via keymapIssues and the setKeymap result.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Runtime replacement without remount, no dropped issues, C1 stays additive.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D11: the Tauri user keymap is loaded through the dialog only (pick_open_path + read_text_file) and persisted with LocalKeymapStore.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Satisfies 'dialog or app config dir' without new Rust commands or capabilities.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D12: KeymapStore is async and validation-free; LocalKeymapStore enforces only the byte limit and exception safety.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Apps decide what to save; the Tauri example saves only error-free compiles.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D13: the prompt applies compiled cmdline (c) maps as a single-step key translation.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Compiled c maps are not silently ignored.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D14: noop-write ex forwarding splits a trailing ! into bang.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Engine bug (controller.ts:655 forwarded bang:false for q!) fixed during integration so :q! can skip the guard.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D15 / DR-06: the adapter owns a cancelable setTimeout/queueMicrotask scheduler passed through VimEngineOptions.timer and cancelled on detach; no public timer option.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The controller fallback timer only runs ms===0, so mapped-prefix timeouts (timeoutlen) never fired.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Waves [p08, p09] -> [p03] -> [p06, p10] -> [p07]; README.md is written by p10 and only appended by p07 as a sharedPath.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Disjoint writePaths per wave; tightly coupled example files stay in one plan.

intentionalTradeoffs: Toggling vim remounts the editor and loses undo history.
The bar caret stays visible behind the mark-based block cursor until user-qa #1 is decided.
V7 native dirty-on-launch observation will likely be recorded as not observed (no GUI session).
README (p10) is written in parallel with p06; drift is caught by p07 V4 and the final review.
':w!' is not mapped in the example ex table and falls through to E492 (not in accepted scope).
Wave-1 per-plan npx tsc --noEmit may surface sibling in-progress errors; full gates run in p07 and serial reconciliation.
supportedEdgeCases: Invalid keymap JSON, wrong version, non-string/object input or unknown preset yields issues; the previous keymap and base vim keep working.
setKeymap(null) resets to base bindings and flushes a pending mapped prefix without duplicating text.
detach cancels all pending timers before controller dispose; no onChange after detach.
Paste/cut during an open prompt never mutates the document; paste appends the first line to the prompt.
Meta-modified keys return false, so app shortcuts work in every mode including during a prompt.
:q is guarded, :q! skips the guard; :e path with a declined discard or declined native confirmation leaves text, title and position unchanged.
LocalKeymapStore: oversized (UTF-8 bytes) text is rejected without setItem; throwing or missing storage resolves null/unavailable and never rejects.
Keymap load with a cancelled pick or an invalid file leaves storage, the live keymap and the document unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria: VimController gains setKeymap(keymap: CompiledKeymap | null): void and readonly cmdline: ReadonlyMap<VimKey, VimKey>; host.ts diff is additive only.
The construction-time keymap also sets cmdline; setKeymap(null) leaves cmdline empty and base bindings active.
:q! reaches ex as {name: 'q', bang: true, args: '', line: 'q!'}; :wq! as {name: 'wq', bang: true}; E492 fallback unchanged.
All existing test/vim suites plus the new search-ex cases pass; no core src edits outside src/vim.
src/vim/keymap-store.ts exports KeymapStoreSaveResult, KeymapStore and LocalKeymapStore({key?, storage?}) exactly as C7, default key emaki.vim.keymap.

UTF-8 byte limit KEYMAP_MAX_BYTES enforced on save (too-large, no setItem) and load (null, value kept); missing or throwing storage yields null/unavailable; methods never reject; text stored verbatim with no parsing.
Existing keymap-store cases unchanged; every new LocalKeymapStore row passes; no forbidden strings.
